ns2:course.label: Special Topics in Architectural History
ns2:course.description: Special topics in Architectural History courses. Topics and subject matter to be published in course listings. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: ARCH 210 or consent of instructor.
